author: Levi.A
description: Talk to your KiraAI bot inside VRChat: push-to-talk voice → cloud speech-to-text → reply in the game chatbox. Keyboard and VR-controller PTT (via OVR Advanced Settings Key Press).

zh.description: 在 VRChat 游戏内与 KiraAI bot 对话：按键说话 → 云端语音识别 → 回复发送到游戏聊天框。支持键盘与 VR 手柄按键说话（经 OVR Advanced Settings）。
